result: Successfully enhanced the NL Workflow frontend module with streaming sendMessage, edge visualization, node configuration preview, improved progress display, context-aware suggestions, and workflow validation display.
features_added: 1. Streaming sendMessage - Added streamMessage method to API client and streaming support in sendMessage function with real-time token updates
2. Edge/Connection Visualization - Added CSS-based edge visualization with SVG arrows between nodes, color-coded by labels (green for '通过'/success, red for '拒绝'/fail, cyan for default)
3. Node Configuration Preview - Added inline node selection and editing panel for basic config fields (name, model, prompt)
4. Better Workflow Generation Progress Display - Added stage display with animated indicator, estimated time remaining, and token count
5. Suggestion Chips Enhancement - Added context-aware suggestions including '撤销上次更改', '尝试使用其他模型' (on failure), and '简化工作流' (when >15 nodes)
6. Pinia Store Integration - Added streamSendMessage method to nlWorkflow store with SSE parsing for streaming responses
7. Workflow Validation Display - Added validation results showing errors (red), warnings (yellow), estimated cost, node count, and edge count
summary: Enhanced the NL Workflow frontend module with 7 major enhancements: (1) Streaming sendMessage with real-time token updates and partial JSON parsing, (2) Edge visualization in workflow preview showing connections with color-coded arrows based on labels, (3) Node configuration preview allowing inline editing of node settings, (4) Enhanced progress display with stage indicators, token count, and time estimates, (5) Context-aware suggestion system that adapts based on workflow state and errors, (6) Pinia store integration with streamSendMessage action, and (7) Workflow validation display showing errors, warnings, costs, and statistics.
